# Exo Cinema support

Start with [Getting started](../docs/HELP.md) for installing, signing in to Jellyfin, the player, Settings and updates.

- [Download the latest release](https://github.com/UhhErix/ExoCinema/releases/latest)
- [Report a problem or suggest a feature](https://github.com/UhhErix/ExoCinema/issues/new/choose)
- [Report a security problem privately](https://github.com/UhhErix/ExoCinema/security/advisories/new)

Issues are public. Remove your server's address, user names and other private details from screenshots and log excerpts before posting.
